data.name: Cristoforo
data.gender_notes: Cristoforo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Christian tradition, the name Cristoforo signifies the bearer or carrier of Christ. It is derived from the Greek name Christos, meaning 'anointed one'. Cristoforo is a name deeply rooted in faith and spirituality, representing the connection between God and humanity. The name Cristoforo carries the meaning “Bearer of Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cristoforo usually hope their child will grow to embody bearer of christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of carrying the love and grace of Christ
data.etymology: Cristoforo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bearer of Christ.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cristoforo total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: קריסטופורו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קריסטופורו מקורו במילים 'קריסטוס' (המשיח) ו'פורוס' (נושא), ומשמעותו 'נושא המשיח' או 'הובלתו של ישו'. השם משקף את הדמות הנושאת את ישו בלבו ומובילה את דרכו הרוחנית.

in_greek.name: Χριστόφορος
in_greek.meaning: Φορέας του Χριστού, οδηγός του Ιησού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χριστόφορος προέρχεται από τις λέξεις 'Χριστός' (ο Μεσσίας) και 'φορέας' (αυτός που φέρει), που σημαίνει 'αυτός που φέρει τον Χριστό' ή 'οδηγός του Ιησού'. Το όνομα αντανακλά την προσωπικότητα που φέρει τον Ιησού στην καρδιά της και οδηγεί την πνευματική της πορεία.

in_latin.name: Christophorus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Christophorus derivatur ex vocibus 'Christus' (Messias) et 'ferens' (qui fert), significans 'qui Christum fert' vel 'ductor Iesu'. Nomen reflectit characterem qui Iesum in corde suo fert et viam suam spiritualem ducit.

in_english.name: Cristoforo
in_english.meaning: Bearer of Christ, Christ-bearer, or one who carries Jesus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cristoforo originates from the Greek words 'Christos' (Χριστός), meaning 'anointed one' or 'Messiah', and 'phoros' (φορά), meaning 'bearer' or 'carrier'. It signifies one who carries or bears Christ, reflecting a spiritual leader or a devout follower of Jesus. Historically, the name has been associated with Saint Christopher, a 3rd-century martyr and patron saint of travelers, symbolizing guidance and protection on life's journey.

data.cultural_impact: The name Cristoforo holds a significant cultural impact, especially within Christian communities, as it carries a strong connection to the ongoing narrative of the Christian faith. Introducing a child with this name to family and community aligns them not only to their religious heritage but also conveys their divine origin to others.
data.spiritual_significance: Renouncing the name Cristoforo signifies accepting the responsibility of carrying the love, teachings, and values of Christ throughout one's life. It serves as a constant reminder of the give-and-take relationship between God and man and the interconnectedness of all beings in the spirit of love and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cristoforo means "Bearer of Christ" in Italian. This name symbolizes the deep Christian faith of the bearer, who carries the love and teachings of Christ in their heart and actions. It is a reminder to live a life guided by Christ's teachings and to spread His love to others.

historical_references.reference: Born in Florence, Italy, in 1451, Cristoforo Buonarroti, later known as Michelangelo, was a renowned artist, architect, and poet of the Italian High Renaissance.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Cristoforo remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Cristoforo from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Cristoforo - "Bearer of Christ". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
